name: Redkihl Rokk's spider droid
description: Redkihl Rokk's spider droids were droids used by Redkihl Rokk to attempt to kill Han Solo, Leia Organa, C-3PO, and Chewbacca while they were aboard his ship. Before the Empire, Redkihl Rokk used these to stun opponents on a ship so he could loot the ship of valuable items.
